notConnected.title: I can already help you without your tools.
notConnected.reason: No calendar and no mailbox are connected to this workspace.
notConnected.stillPossible: I work from your commercial audit, your accounts and whatever you import.
notConnected.unlocks: Connect them and I add your meetings, the replies waiting for you and your follow-ups.

connectedNotSynced.title: Your tool is connected, but I haven’t read it yet.
connectedNotSynced.reason: The first read hasn’t happened: nothing started on its own when you connected.
connectedNotSynced.stillPossible: You can keep working on your accounts and your audit in the meantime.
connectedNotSynced.unlocks: One first read and your day fills up with your real meetings and real exchanges.

syncing.title: I’m reading your sources right now.
syncing.reason: The read is under way: what’s missing here isn’t absent, it hasn’t arrived yet.
syncing.stillPossible: You can leave this screen, the read carries on without you.
syncing.unlocks: When it ends, I tell you what I found and what I couldn’t make sense of.

readyEmpty.title: I looked, and there’s nothing for today.
readyEmpty.reason: Your sources answered: that’s a fact, not a failed read.
readyEmpty.stillPossible: This is the moment to go looking: an account to analyse, a message to prepare.
readyEmpty.unlocks: As soon as a meeting, a reply or a signal turns up, it shows here.

partial.title: One source is missing: this list is incomplete.
partial.reason: One of your sources didn’t answer. What you see is true, it isn’t everything.
partial.stillPossible: You can work on what I already have — nothing is lost.
partial.unlocks: The missing source may hold exactly what would fill your day.

missingScope.title: Your tool is connected, but it doesn’t let me read.
missingScope.reason: The permission granted doesn’t cover the read I need.
missingScope.stillPossible: You can work from an import in the meantime.
missingScope.unlocks: Renew the permission and this part of your day switches on.

permissionDenied.title: This access isn’t open to you in this workspace.
permissionDenied.reason: It’s a right, not a failure: someone administers this access and it hasn’t been given to you.
permissionDenied.stillPossible: Everything that doesn’t depend on this access is still yours.
permissionDenied.unlocks: Once the access is open, this part appears with nothing else to do.

stale.title: What I’m showing you here is old.
stale.reason: The last read is old: these lines may be wrong today.
stale.stillPossible: You can read them knowing when they’re from — the date is written.
stale.unlocks: A fresh read and you get the real state of your day back.

unavailable.title: Your source didn’t answer.
unavailable.reason: The read failed just now. Nothing already there is lost.
unavailable.stillPossible: The rest of your day is intact, and you can try again.
unavailable.unlocks: As soon as the source answers, this part comes back as it was.

error.title: Something broke on my side.
error.reason: This isn’t an empty day: I couldn’t do what I had to do.
error.stillPossible: Whatever was already computed stays on screen, with its date.
error.unlocks: Once the failure is past, there’s nothing for you to redo.

verdict.projectNoNextAction: This deal has no next step planned.

verdict.craMissing: No timesheet, no invoice: the timesheet comes first.

verdict.invoiceBlocked: This month's invoice is blocked by the named point.
verdict.criticalDataMissing: A critical piece of data is missing, and what follows depends on it.
